name: solarna-mobile
description: Solarna native application shells for Android and iOS

scripts.test: npm run test:dependencies && node scripts/test-config.mjs && node scripts/test-system-config.mjs && node scripts/test-result-summary.mjs && node scripts/test-cloud-storage.mjs && node scripts/test-install-support.mjs && node scripts/test-release-scripts.mjs && node scripts/test-ios-project.mjs
scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run prepare:web && cap sync ios
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
